fields.label: Introduction
fields.default: Paxofi Technologies LTD is a digital technology company creating innovative products, dependable platforms and meaningful opportunities that help businesses grow and people build the future.

fields.label: Heading
fields.default: We build digital solutions that solve real problems.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: We are engineers, designers, product thinkers and problem solvers building software, digital products and technology experiences that create value, drive efficiency and empower people. We are early in our journey, building the foundations of something ambitious, and we are looking for people who want to help shape it.

fields.label: Heading
fields.default: From a vision to a growing reality.

fields.label: Milestone 1: text
fields.default: Paxofi Technologies LTD was founded with a clear mission: build technology that empowers businesses and people.

fields.label: Milestone 2: text
fields.default: We built our core team, launched the Paxofi Innovation Fellowship and began developing our first products, Paxofi Pay and the Paxofi Core Framework.

fields.label: Milestone 3: text
fields.default: Expanding our product ecosystem and creating opportunities for more people to build with us.

fields.label: Milestone 4: text
fields.default: Building globally relevant solutions and a community of innovators and change-makers across Africa and beyond.

fields.label: Vision
fields.default: To become one of Africa's leading technology companies, building globally trusted digital products, innovative solutions and transformative technologies that empower people, businesses and communities to thrive in the global digital economy.

fields.label: Mission
fields.default: To design, build and deliver secure, innovative and accessible technology solutions that solve real-world problems, empower people and businesses, and drive digital transformation across Africa and the global economy.

fields.label: Heading
fields.default: One fellowship. Real projects. Real mentorship.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.default: The Paxofi Innovation Fellowship (PIF) is a structured, remote programme for people who want practical experience, mentorship and the chance to contribute to real products in a technology company.

fields.label: Point 1
fields.default: Remote and open to applicants anywhere

fields.label: Point 2
fields.default: At least 15 hours a week; 20 hours is the normal target

fields.label: Point 3
fields.default: Terms of 3, 6 or 12 months, confirmed at offer

fields.label: Point 4
fields.default: Rolling intake: apply whenever a role fits

fields.label: Point 5
fields.default: No stipend or salary at this time: a learning and development programme

fields.label: Heading
fields.default: Seven role families. Find the one that fits you.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.default: Your journey with Paxofi in five steps.

fields.label: Step 1: text
fields.default: Gain knowledge and understand the problem.

fields.label: Step 2: text
fields.default: Work on real projects and ship meaningful solutions.

fields.label: Step 3: text
fields.default: Work with great people and share ideas.

fields.label: Step 4: text
fields.default: Make an impact and create value for users.

fields.label: Step 5: text
fields.default: Develop your skills and accelerate your future.

fields.label: Heading
fields.default: What you can expect from us

fields.label: Promise 1
fields.default: Clear communication at every step, by email

fields.label: Promise 2
fields.default: Fair, structured evaluation against published criteria

fields.label: Promise 3
fields.default: A respectful experience, whatever the outcome

fields.label: Promise 4
fields.default: Transparent expectations about time and commitment

fields.label: Promise 5
fields.default: Your data handled carefully and only for recruitment

fields.label: Answer 1
fields.default: Anyone aged 18 or over with a genuine interest in the role: students, recent graduates, career changers and experienced professionals. Each role lists what to show us.

fields.label: Answer 2
fields.default: Yes. The fellowship is remote and open to applicants anywhere with a reliable internet connection.

fields.label: Answer 3
fields.default: No. The Paxofi Innovation Fellowship does not offer a stipend, allowance or salary at this time. It is a structured learning, mentorship and professional development programme.

fields.label: Question 4
fields.default: What is the minimum time commitment?

fields.label: Answer 4
fields.default: At least 15 hours a week. 20 hours a week is the normal target.

fields.label: Answer 5
fields.default: Fellowship terms are typically 3, 6 or 12 months, confirmed when an offer is made. Recruitment itself is continuous.

fields.label: Answer 6
fields.default: Application, eligibility screening, shortlist, a short role assessment, a structured interview, a decision, then onboarding.

fields.label: Answer 7
fields.default: You receive an acknowledgement by email, and we email you at every step, whether or not your application moves forward.

fields.label: Question 8
fields.default: Can I apply for more than one role?

fields.label: Answer 8
fields.default: Yes, but choose the role that fits you best. We may suggest a different role during screening.

fields.label: Question 9
fields.default: How can I contact Paxofi about recruitment?

fields.label: Text
fields.default: Paxofi welcomes applicants of every background and is committed to an inclusive, respectful environment. We assess every application on the skills and potential it shows, and we never ask for information we do not need.

fields.label: Text
fields.default: Explore the role families, apply in a few minutes and start your journey with us.
